title: Speck's Moulin Rouge dance hall and the band's wartime job there
summary: Speck, who started bootlegging with a three-piece band, built the Moulin Rouge in wartime. The band played there on and off, with a cowboy band replacing them at times, until the place turned to gambling.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene
